title: Shared breakpoints between a reference and a query genome
description: One row per shared/reused breakpoint between two genomes. Joins synteny block edges with SV-derived BND/INV evidence. Used by future analysis/cross_species_support.js to score breakpoint-reuse evidence for an inversion candidate.

support_class.description: Composite support classification from joined evidence.

evidence_types.description: Comma-separated list of supporting evidence kinds (e.g., 'wfmash,manta_bnd,delly_inv').
